Agent Maturity Compass
  Evidence over claims.

  ✓ Workspace initialized
  → Location: /private/var/folders/kt/r665rkj5159bw9zt4rp2n66c0000gn/T/amc-platform-l7KVkZ/workspace with spaces
  → Three actions reach a first governed, verified turn without any provider key:

  ━━━ What's next ━━━

  1. amc firewall enable — Create and sign the Runtime Firewall policy. Until it exists every workspace tool call (--tools workspace: fs.read, fs.write, bash) is denied (missing-policy). Idempotent; explains what it wrote.
  2. amc --agent default agent-loop run "Check recording with a local demonstration." --provider stub --model amc-stub-1 --tools echo --max-steps 2 --max-tokens 512 — Run the first turn keyless: the stub provider records a canned response through the signed session log (no real model answer). Its echo tool is a demonstration seam outside the firewall and allowlist; workspace tools are what the signed policy governs.
  3. amc agent-loop verify <session-id> — Verify the recorded evidence of that turn; the run prints the session id. Verification checks integrity, not answer quality.


  ━━━ What's next ━━━

  1. amc — Generate the full evidence score immediately
  2. amc config profile dev — Re-apply the selected workspace config profile
  3. amc setup --demo — Load demo data and explore all features
  4. amc doctor — Check what's available in your environment
  5. amc up — Start Studio (web dashboard)

  Full guide: https://github.com/AgentMaturity/AgentMaturityCompass/blob/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md
